The remote target remains an observer and transport initiator only. It must not mutate, synthesize, or directly repair source-owned replica_operations state; the existing canonical source owner performs every workflow transition, including the rearm.

Rearm only the exact parked non-system runtime_service ADD/REPLACE operation whose remote-handoff budget exhausted while its durable row is CREATING and target replica-creation evidence exists. Do not add periodic broad rediscovery of CREATING rows, blind duplicate CREATE dispatch, timers or retry maps that bypass authoritative row refresh, or any widening of operation budgets or the initial-placement timeout.

Terminalization must require the existing exact replica_id plus target_node_id services observation to be ACTIVE. An absent, wrong-node, CREATED, CREATING, FAILED, STOPPED, partition fallback, or unrelated service row must not terminalize the operation, and missing local operation-row visibility must defer, never fabricate, the operation row.

The budget hold blocking the subsequent ADD is released only as a consequence of the parked operation reaching a canonical terminal through the source owner, never by clearing or resetting budget state independently of the operation outcome.

Before source change acceptance, a deterministic production-seam discriminator must reproduce the exact 2026-07-21T13:35 live ordering (remote replica created, source row CREATING with missing local operation-row visibility, handoff budget exhausted, second ADD budget-blocked, no rearm before initial-placement timeout), stay red on current HEAD, be red-on-revert for any fix, and include negative controls for broad non-system create replay and for system-operation byte-identical behavior.
